aj: quick q — we currently return 429 for both tenant quota hits and routing backpressure. customers (and the console) can't reliably tell which is which. proposal: add a tiny machine-readable subcode header `x-redwood-subcode` with values like `quota_exhausted`, `route_backpressure`, `soft_throttle`, `dedicated_limit`. also surface a short human `error_hint` for console badging. thoughts?
maria: yes to subcodes. big + for human-friendly hints too. one ask: how will this affect retry semantics? i.e. `quota_exhausted` should be terminal, `soft_throttle` retriable. we should include `Retry-After` where appropriate.
devon: concern: SDK churn. if we add `x-redwood-subcode` please keep a stable enum and doc it in SDKs. default behavior: legacy clients ignore header and keep working. also we should emit `route.origin` telemetry tag (`regional|fallback|dedicated`) so infra can see where the pressure is coming from.
han: for console UX we want a single-line badge mapping. examples: `Quota exhausted — see Billing → Quotas` or `Served from fallback region (higher latency)`. small copy + link. also: can we attach a runbook id like `runbook:RB-204` in the console link?
aj: agree on enums + Retry-After mapping. rough mapping i'm thinking: `quota_exhausted` -> 429 terminal + `error_hint` "quota usage exceeded for tenant" (no retry), `soft_throttle` -> 429 retriable + `Retry-After` + `error_hint` "temporarily overloaded, retry in Ns", `route_backpressure` -> 502/503? currently we send 502 for some internal routing failures — maybe keep code but add subcode `route_backpressure` so clients can disambiguate.
maria: question — do we want to expose route origin for privacy/regulation reasons? some customers might not want region info surfaced in client responses. maybe make route origin opt-in per tenant (console flag)?
devon: good call. default: emit telemetry always, but only surface `route.origin` in responses if tenant has `expose_route_origin` enabled. console toggles that. keeps telemetry intact for infra.
han: for the console dashboard: we should have a new breakdown by subcode, and a heatmap of routes causing `route_backpressure`. product will need sample payloads for the badging.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: rollout v1 of header logic to canary completed in us-west-2 at 2024-11-05T15:03:12Z :rocket:
aj: rollout plan suggestion: (1) metrics-only spike for 2 weeks (emit subcode in logs only), (2) opt-in response header via tenant flag for next 4 weeks, (3) default-on after compatibility telemetry looks good. will open RFC + migration checklist.
maria: add to RFC: console badge copy, runbook link, and guidance for partners (marketplaces). also include a note for support playbooks.
devon: SDK action item: add enum, expose `response.subcode` and map to retry helpers. i'll draft PRs after RFC.
aj: thanks — i'll open RFC today (will link here). if no blockers i'll start the metrics-only spike early next week.
